text: Cycling is a popular exercise and transportation method that promotes health and environmental sustainability. One critical component of cycling is the helmet, which protects the head in case of falls. While helmets are not the sole focus of cycling, they are often the first item considered to ensure safety. When beginning a cycling journey, proper gear such as a good bicycle and appropriate clothing is essential, but the helmet remains a fundamental part of cycling safety. As cyclists progress, they can choose between various gear configurations to optimize performance and comfort, such as changing gears to climb steep hills or maintain steady speeds on flat terrains.
